title: tandpfun/wardrobe
method: discovery + usage signals (forks/contributors/commits/downloads) Chinese-side corroboration added 2026-08-06: the same ask surfaced twice independently, from two different commenters, inside one 1.7万-like / 6097-comment Xiaohongshu note — read out of the note's own page state rather than from a search snippet.

zh.gap: 只有极客能用——npm、.env、API key、参考照——而'穿在我身上看看'恰恰是现有衣橱应用（Whering、Acloset、Indyx）还没做好的那一件事。

zh.pain: 想要一个以自己为模特的数字衣橱的人——但今天得 git clone、配 OpenAI key、放参考照片，只有极客能看到自己的穿搭册。
zh.kill: 衣橱类是消费级产品的坟场：留存低、老玩家已占住非技术用户，按图生成的成本会吃掉微薄的订阅毛利；仓库只有 1 个贡献者，上线当天后再无提交。
zh.move: 跳过衣橱管理的红海，只卖那一个魔法时刻——传 20 张衣服照片，得到一本自己试穿的穿搭册——做成付费移动端流程。 冷启动第一步：中文＝小红书「衣柜整理」「穿搭记录」笔记评论区，免费替人把二十件衣服拍成一本本人上身的搭配册；英文＝r/femalefashionadvice 与 r/declutter 的衣橱盘点帖，一帖一本免费搭配册。

pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that helps users manage their wardrobe, which can be monetized through a subscription or one-time fee.

gap: Only geeks can use it — npm, .env, API key, reference photo — while the 'see it on me' generation feature is exactly what existing closet apps (Whering, Acloset, Indyx) don't do well yet.
pain: People who want a digital closet with themselves as the model — but today that takes git clone, an OpenAI key and a reference PNG, so only geeks get the lookbook.
kill: Closet apps are a graveyard of low-retention consumer products, incumbents already own the non-technical audience, and per-image generation costs eat thin subscription margins; 1 contributor, no commits since launch day.
move: Skip the closet-manager race; sell the one magic moment — upload 20 photos of your clothes, get a modeled lookbook of yourself — as a paid mobile flow. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书「衣柜整理」「穿搭记录」笔记评论区，免费替人把二十件衣服拍成一本本人上身的搭配册; Cold start (English): r/femalefashionadvice and r/declutter closet-inventory threads, one free lookbook per thread.
